text: 英国央行警告称，人工智能领域的估值仍面临比7月更“剧烈的调整”，并指出此类崩盘对全球经济增长和主权债券收益率可能带来的广泛影响。英国央行政策制定者在季度金融稳定报告中表示，金融体系中的相互关联脆弱性正在上升，多重风险同时爆发的可能性增加。规模达数万亿美元的人工智能市场是风险的重要来源之一，此外，中东冲突“再次升级”也是风险因素。英国央行认为，中东局势升级可能导致全球经济遭遇“持续时间更长的负面供给冲击”，进而提高主权债务风险。该央行此前已多次警告，包括AI相关股票、信贷市场以及主权债务在内的多个领域可能正在形成资产泡沫。
text_en: The Bank of England warned that valuations in the artificial intelligence sector still face more "violent adjustments" than in July, and pointed out the broad impact such a crash could have on global economic growth and sovereign bond yields. In its quarterly financial stability report, Bank of England policymakers said interconnected vulnerabilities in the financial system are rising, increasing the possibility of multiple risks erupting simultaneously. The multi-trillion-dollar artificial intelligence market is one important source of risk, and the "renewed escalation" of conflict in the Middle East is also a risk factor. The Bank of England believes that escalation in the Middle East could cause the global economy to suffer a "longer-lasting negative supply shock," thereby increasing sovereign debt risk. The central bank has repeatedly warned previously that asset bubbles may be forming in multiple areas, including AI-related stocks, credit markets, and sovereign debt.
